recreation_brief:
1. SLIDE SETUP: Set the slide background to light gray #F2F2F2 and draw a dark red (#A62323) unfilled rectangular outline inset ~2% from every edge to frame all content.
2. TITLE: Insert a text box at top-left (x≈4%, y≈5%, width≈41%, height≈7%) containing 'Remember: ' in italic blue (#1F4FD8) followed by 'Derivative of Sigmoid Function' in bold dark red (#B02418); sans-serif, approximately 32 pt.
3. SLIDE NUMBER: Draw a yellow (#FFFF00) circle about 4-5% of the slide width in diameter at the far top-right (x≈94%, y≈4%) with the black text '4' centered inside.
4. CHART: Insert a small line chart at top-right (x≈70-92%, y≈10-30%) titled f(x)=\frac{1}{(1+e^{-x})}. Plot the sigmoid curve in red (#E33E2B) passing through (0, 0.5) and saturating toward 0 and 1; set x-axis ticks to -6, -4, -2, 0, 2, 4, 6 and y-axis ticks to 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1; use black axes and text on a white plot area and add the legend entry 'sigmoid'.
5. DEFINITION: Place a text box at upper-left (x≈4-40%, y≈32-40%) with the equation O_j = f(Net_j) = \frac{1}{(1+e^{-Net_j})} rendered as math with subscripts in black.
6. NEURON DIAGRAM: Immediately to the right of the definition (x≈45-65%, y≈30-45%) draw, left to right: a blue (#1F4FD8) circle labeled 'Σ'; a black right-pointing arrow labeled 'Net'; and a small white box containing a red (#E33E2B) line-art sigmoid-curve icon.
7. DERIVATION STACK: Stack exactly 4 white rectangles with thin gray (#BFBFBF) borders at center-left (x≈4-65%, y≈45-80%; each box ≈8% of slide height with small vertical gaps). Box 1 text: f'(Net_j)=\frac{(1+e^{-Net_j})\cdot e^{-Net_j}}{(1+e^{-Net_j})(1+e^{-Net_j})}=\frac{1*(1+e^{-Net_j})-1}{(1+e^{-Net_j})(1+e^{-Net_j})}. Box 2 text: f'(Net_j)=\frac{1}{(1+e^{-Net_j})}\left( \frac{(1+e^{-Net_j})-1}{(1+e^{-Net_j})} \right). Box 3 text: = \frac{1}{(1+e^{-Net_j})}\left( \frac{(1+e^{-Net_j})}{(1+e^{-Net_j})} - \frac{1}{(1+e^{-Net_j})} \right). Box 4 text: f'(Net_j)=\frac{1}{(1+e^{-Net_j})}\left[ 1 - \frac{1}{(1+e^{-Net_j})} \right]. Render all four as math with subscripts; color every 'Net_j' and the standalone '-1' terms blue (#1F4FD8); all other equation text black.
8. ARROW: Draw one blue (#1F4FD8) curved arrow starting at the right edge of Box 4 and ending at the final result box.
9. FINAL RESULT: Draw a tan (#F5D0A9) rounded rectangle at bottom-right (x≈58-92%, y≈78-90%) containing => f'(Net_j)=O_j(1-O_j), with 'O_j' in dark red (#C00000) and the remaining text black.
